scope: Independent C020r/s algebra and order-case audit, h>0, 1/4<=t<=5/18.
required_bounds: Both outer E<0, retaining h>0 and t endpoints; no uniform positive gap as h tends to zero is required.

analytic_review.reference_roots: Four disjoint sign intervals, with J(eta)<0 and J(+/-h)>0, exhaust quartic degree and force simplicity.
analytic_review.strict_branch: alpha_4>eta_+>0; if alpha_3<0 then J(-alpha_3)<0, forcing -alpha_3<alpha_4; hence r>2.
analytic_review.denominators: A(alpha_i) nonzero by strict locations; |W|>2 and t>0 make W^2(W^2+8t-4)>0.
analytic_review.endpoints: Each linear coefficient is minimized at 5/18; the quadratic decreasing coefficient has the saved exact nonnegative endpoint difference.
analytic_review.counts: Every order row has three strict (-,+,-) values. Positive monic even-degree ends give four disjoint real-root intervals. Residual degree four forces simplicity.
analytic_review.shared_roots: Strictly signed points cannot equal d; no division at other points or assumption H(d)!=0 is made.
analytic_review.transfer: Centering has h^2=(l^2-4k)/(4k^2)>0; positive scaling k^2 and translation preserve all multiplicities; collision d=-m.

limitations: No full general-input or higher-symbol-degree count theorem.
